WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    o.timespan,
    AVG(CASE 
        WHEN f.feerate IS NOT NULL AND f.feerate != 0 AND f.rebrate IS NOT NULL
        THEN f.rebrate / f.feerate 
      END) as avg_ratio,
    COUNT(f.feesnode) as fee_count
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
avg_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(fee_count) as avg_fee_count
  FROM grouped
),
kept_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    g.avg_ratio,
    g.fee_count,
    a.avg_fee_count
  FROM grouped g
  CROSS JOIN avg_count a
  WHERE g.fee_count > a.avg_fee_count
)
SELECT 
  AVG(kg.avg_ratio) as avg_of_avg_ratios,
  SUM(kg.fee_count) as sum_of_fee_counts,
  AVG(kg.fee_count - kg.avg_fee_count) as avg_excess
FROM kept_groups kg

assumptions.assumption: feerate is never exactly 0; if it is, records with feerate = 0 are excluded from the rebrate/feerate ratio calculation to avoid division by zero errors
